# Learning Roadmap

## Foundation Modules

| Module | Topic                     | Output              |
|--------|---------------------------|---------------------|
| 1      | R Fundamentals            | Data Import Report  |
| 2      | Data Cleaning             | Clean Dataset       |
| 3      | Descriptive Statistics    | Descriptive Report  |
| 4      | Correlation & Regression  | Regression Report   |
| 5      | PLS-SEM                   | SEM Results         |
| 6      | Visualization & Reporting | Publication Figures |

## Advanced Analytics Modules

| Module | Topic                       |
|--------|-----------------------------|
| A1     | Descriptive Diagnostics     |
| A2     | Advanced Regression         |
| A3     | Ridge, LASSO & Elastic Net  |
| A4     | Advanced SEM                |
| A5     | Bayesian Statistics         |
| A6     | Monte Carlo Simulation      |
| A7     | Simpson's Paradox           |
| A8     | Advanced Likert Analysis    |
| A9     | Visualization Gallery       |
| A10    | Research Toolkit            |
| A11    | Meta-analysis               |
| A12    | Bibliometric Analysis       |
| A13    | Experimental Design & ANOVA |
| A14    | Mixed Models                |
| A15    | Reproducible Research       |
